question: How are impurity and karma well established as Shiva-will alone?
premises: for action, impurity and karma, as Shiva-will alone — well established
inference: Mala-karma rest on sole Shiva-will; Shiva shines by own form anywhere.
plain_english: For action, impurity and karma, as Shiva-will alone — well established; but in whatever Shiva by own form shines.
